title: Paul McCartney live: Foro Sol, Mexico City | 2023
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Foro Sol stadium in Mexico City, Mexico, on 16 November 2023.

It was the 27th show of the Got Back Tour, which lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025, and the second of two nights at Foro Sol.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

McCartney previously performed at Foro Sol on 25 and 27 November 1993 during the New World Tour, and 27 and 28 May 2010 during the Up And Coming Tour. He returned there on 12 and 14 November 2024 during the Got Back Tour.
